Panoptic is a decentralized options protocol that operates through smart contracts on a public blockchain. Panoptic is built on top of Uniswap v3 liquidity positions. Panoptic offers perpetual options that do not have a fixed expiry date.

Hegic is a decentralized options protocol that operates through smart contracts on a public blockchain. Hegic uses liquidity pools that are provided by liquidity providers to write options. Hegic allows users to buy options without an intermediary counterparty.

Opyn v2 is a decentralized options protocol that operates through smart contracts on a public blockchain. Opyn v2 represents options as tokenized positions that can be traded or transferred. Opyn v2 is non-custodial, so users keep control of their collateral through smart contracts.
